title: Distinguishes platform-initiated account rejections from Stripe rejections
summary: Updates the requirements.disabled_reason and future_requirements.disabled_reason properties on the v1 Account object to distinguish between platform-initiated rejections and Stripe rejections. Previously, platform-rejected accounts returned rejected.fraud, rejected.terms_of_service, or rejected.other for these properties. They now return: The values returned in requirements.disabled_reason and future_requirements.disabled_reason for your platform-rejected accounts change when you upgrade to this API version. If your integration checks the previous values to identify platform rejections, you need to update this logic to handle the new values. You can now use these properties to determine whether the platform or Stripe rejected the account.

migrationNotes.text: Update any rejection-handling logic that checks requirements.disabled_reason or future_requirements.disabled_reason to handle the new rejected.platform_* values. See the versioned Account API reference for all supported rejection reasons.
